_comment: Portrait registry — maps composition keys to image paths. Lookup order in monster-image-resolver-service.js: Type:Domain:Role → Type:Role → Type:Domain → Type → actor.img → mystery-man. Keys are colon-delimited. Type names match TypeDropdown values (HiddenFolk, Beast, Undead, etc.). Domain/Role names match ChangeSet concept names without the (Family) parenthetical (e.g., 'Wood', 'Wolf', 'Sidhe'). Add entries here; re-run Setup Data to load.
